source.probe: hb-shape of a 57-letter Arabic pangram, 278 vs 325 at 12pt; box = Calibri hhea 1536/512 over 2048

note:
Calibri ships its own compact Arabic; Carlito has none, so Arabic in a
cs="Calibri" run would fall through to Geeza Pro (8.6% wider, taller box).
Scale = shaped width of a 57-letter Arabic pangram in Calibri vs the bundled
Noto Sans Arabic subset (harfbuzz over the real files, 2026-10-14: 278 vs
325 at 12 pt; bold cut 0.902, synthesized from the regular group). Box
pinned to Calibri's hhea 1536/512 over 2048 so the fallback face never
lifts a Calibri line.
